title: Result/leaderboard product fields and ranking UX remain thinner than the stated specification

original_titles.title: LBD-01: no own-row highlight/pin, search, pagination or provisional badge; live-mode constraints unenforced
RES-01/RES-02: rank, per-challenge totals, bugs missed, certificate and public results missing
Leaderboard snapshot served no-store instead of cacheable 10s (LBD-01c)

problem: The current result API returns a released total, component breakdown and ledger entries, but some specification fields such as rank, per-challenge totals, bugs missed and downloadable certificate are absent. Leaderboard is snapshot-driven and lacks conditional since/version responses; participant own-row emphasis/search/pagination are incomplete.
impact: Participants may not have enough context to understand the result, and repeated polling can reload unchanged snapshots. This is mainly a product/UX completeness issue after the score correctness bug is fixed separately.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Agree the result schema and data definitions: rank, challenge/level subtotals, penalties, bugs found/missed (if safe to disclose), tie-break result and certificate eligibility.
Return leaderboard snapshot version and `since`/ETag semantics so clients can avoid full payload refresh when unchanged.
Add participant own-team highlight, accessible ranking table, filters and pagination without revealing hidden feedback before release.
Generate any certificate/export only after finalization and include the result snapshot/config hash.
Add release-state tests proving no hidden ranking or matched bug detail leaks before allowed release.

acceptance_criteria: Published result fields match the approved rules and reconcile to the score ledger.
Unchanged leaderboard versions avoid unnecessary payload transfer.
No pre-release result oracle is reintroduced.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
